name: Wikidata Source Saver
description: Press a shortcut to add 'described at URL' (P1343 + P2699) to the Wikidata item or lexeme in your clipboard, for configured websites.

action.default_title: Save this page as a source on the Wikidata item or lexeme in your clipboard

save-source.description: Save current URL (and the same term on related websites) as P1343/P2699 on the item or lexeme in the clipboard

save-this-only.description: Save only the current page (skip related websites)

create-item.description: Create a new Wikidata item from this page (uses the website's recipe in Settings)

configure-site.description: Configure a website from the item / property in the clipboard (Label (Q123) or Label (P123))
